<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Probe: click the red block at (26, 14) to see what shifts
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 26, 'col': 14}])

print(f"Board changed: {last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")

# Compare before and after
if last_transition:
    before = last_transition.before_frame
    after = last_transition.after_frame
    
    # Get squares before
    before_sq = {}
    for n in before.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] == 4:
            b = n['boundary']
            min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
            min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
            before_sq[(min_r, min_c)] = n['color']
    
    # Get squares after
    after_sq = {}
    for n in after.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] == 4:
            b = n['boundary']
            min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
            min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
            after_sq[(min_r, min_c)] = n['color']
    
    # Find differences
    all_pos = set(before_sq.keys()) | set(after_sq.keys())
    changes = []
    for pos in sorted(all_pos):
        bc = before_sq.get(pos, '?')
        ac = after_sq.get(pos, '?')
        if bc != ac:
            changes.append((pos, bc, ac))
    
    print(f"\nChanges ({len(changes)}):")
    for pos, bc, ac in changes:
        print(f"  {pos}: {bc} -> {ac}")
    
    # Check green strip
    for n in after.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] <= 64:
            print(f"\nGreen strip: {n['pixels']}px")
</parameter>
</function>
